answer: The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, forfeited on duplicate submission, idle agents bleed standing. The river holds work receipts rather than names, so the forge of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. What survives to the mesa is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
